passages.P2: stated on October 24, 2020 in a text post:
passages.P3: “The daughter of Sen. Coons (D-DE), along with 7 other underaged girls are featured on Hunter’s laptop! – Breitbart News”
passages.P4: In this Oct. 11, 2012, file photo, Hunter Biden waits for the start of the vice presidential debate where his father, Vice President Joe Biden appeared, at Centre College in Danville, Ky. (AP)
passages.P8: # No evidence Hunter Biden had photos of Coons’ daughter
passages.P10:
* There is no evidence that a computer hard drive previously belonging to Hunter Biden contains illicit images of the teenage daughter of Sen. Chris Coons, D-Del.
* The claim comes from Lauren Witzke, a Republican running against Coons to represent Delaware in the Senate. She has not offered proof.
passages.P11: See the sources for this fact-check
passages.P12: The unproven claims of a Delaware Senate candidate have inspired a rash of conspiratorial Facebook posts about Joe Biden’s son.
passages.P13: An Oct. 24 post claims a conservative news outlet reported that a laptop belonging to Hunter Biden contains illicit images of the daughter of Sen. Chris Coons, D-Del.
passages.P14: “BREAKING: The daughter of Sen. Coons (D-DE), along with 7 other underaged girls are featured on Hunter’s laptop! – Breitbart News,” the post says.
passages.P15: The post was flagged as part of Facebook’s efforts to combat false news and misinformation on its News Feed. (Read more about our partnership with Facebook.) The claim has also made its way to TikTok and YouTube.
passages.P16: Since the New York Post published a story Oct. 14 in which it claimed to have information from a computer hard drive owned by Hunter Biden, similar unproven attacks against him have swirled on social media. So we took a closer look at this claim.
passages.P18: There is no evidence that a computer hard drive previously belonging to Hunter Biden contains illicit images of Coons’ teenage daughter. The claim comes from a U.S. Senate candidate who has previously shared posts related to QAnon, a baseless conspiracy theory about child sex trafficking.
passages.P19: On Oct. 24, Lauren Witzke, a Republican who’s running against Coons to represent Delaware in the Senate, tweeted an audio clip from an interview with Breitbart News. The post has been shared more than 8,700 times and amplified by conservative outlets like the Gateway Pundit.
passages.P20: During the interview, Witzke made a variety of accusations against Joe Biden, including that he is “owned by China.” While discussing Hunter Biden’s purported laptop, she said: “Chris Coons’ daughter, in addition to seven other underage girls, are also featured on the laptop.”
passages.P21: Breitbart did not independently report this as news, as the Facebook posts make it seem.
passages.P22: Coons is one of Joe Biden’s biggest supporters in Washington, and his daughter has previously been the subject of disinformation that falsely claims Biden is a pedophile. One often-used photo shows Biden touching her arm as he leans in to whisper something.
passages.P23: In her interview with Breitbart, Witzke cited “sources close to and that have deep knowledge in the investigation.” We reached out to her for evidence to substantiate her comments, but she did not offer any. We haven’t heard back from the Biden campaign.

passages.P1: Two former FBI officials charged with lying to Congress about their participation in investigations involving Hunter Biden, the son of former President Joe Biden, are due back in court.
passages.P2: WASHINGTON (AP) — Two former FBI officials charged with lying to Congress about their participation in investigations involving Hunter Biden, the son of former President Joe Biden, are due back in court Tuesday in a case their lawyers have described as baseless and politically motivated.
passages.P3: The prosecution of Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides, announced Friday, is the latest in a series of splashy and politically charged investigative actions the Justice Department has undertaken in the run-up to next week’s midterm elections.
passages.P4: The case accuses the former officials of falsely playing down their knowledge about a laptop the Justice Department says Hunter Biden abandoned at a computer repair shop in 2019. But beyond that, it represents a Trump administration broadside against a since-disbanded FBI task force that was set up to monitor foreign influence. Congressional Republicans have long criticized the task force, saying it tried to discredit their own investigations into the Biden family.
passages.P5: Defense lawyers are expected to challenge the case at a preliminary hearing Tuesday in Washington’s federal court, including by highlighting the unusual fact that the ex-FBI officials were charged via a criminal complaint signed by a magistrate judge rather than an indictment voted on by a grand jury. The Justice Department is thought to have repeatedly struggled in high-profile cases to persuade grand juries in the nation’s capital to return indictments.
passages.P6: It is a very intricate saga
passages.P7: The prosecution, a rare Justice Department criminal case against a former employee, revisits a tangled saga that roiled the final weeks of the 2020 race after the New York Post revealed the existence of a laptop it said had been dropped off by the younger Biden at a Delaware computer repair shop about a year earlier.
passages.P8: The Post said it had obtained a hard drive of the laptop from Rudy Giuliani, a close ally of President Donald Trump, and reported on some of the contents of the computer, including emails that appeared to show some of Hunter Biden’s foreign business dealings.
passages.P9: The curious circumstances of the laptop’s discovery raised concerns among Democrats and former intelligence officials about the possibility of Russian involvement, particularly when the Trump administration’s own intelligence community had assessed that Moscow was attempting to undermine the candidacy of Democratic nominee Joe Biden, who went on to defeat Trump in 2020, and as Giuliani had traveled abroad looking for dirt on the Bidens.
passages.P10: But Trump’s then-national intelligence director, John Ratcliffe, quickly sought to quell speculation about the laptop’s provenance by saying there were no signs it had anything to do with Russian actors. The FBI said it had nothing to add to Ratcliffe’s statement and investigated the younger Biden on gun and tax charges that later resulted in felony convictions. President Joe Biden pardoned his son in late 2024.
passages.P11: The accused led the Foreign Influence Task Force
passages.P12: The FBI officials under scrutiny, Floris and Benavides, were leaders of the Foreign Influence Task Force, which was established in the first Trump administration to police influence campaigns staged by Russia and other nations aimed at sowing discord, undermining democracy and spreading disinformation.
